description:
Description: Takes a single observable (observable_type and observable_value) where observable_type is only url or domain, enriches it with URLScan, and returns one normalized TEDS enrichment. Do not select this component for IP (ipv4, ipv4_public, ipv6), hashes (md5, sha1, sha256), or any other observable type.

Inputs: one observable object with observable_type(url or domain only) and observable_value.

Outputs: one TEDS enrichment.

Configuration: none required.
name: Enrich - URLScan Enrich Observable (VIC)
